newsitem.title: ITALY: ENEL opens two geothermal power stations.
newsitem.headline: ENEL opens two geothermal power stations.

text.p: Italian state-owned electricity generator and distributor ENEL said it had inaugurated two new geothermal power stations in Monteverdi Marittimo, Pisa, in north central Italy with an investment of 210 billion lire ($120.7 million).
These two power plants have an overall capacity of 40 megawatts (MW) and are able to meet the requirements of 350,000 people, an ENEL statement said.
ENEL added that in the next five years there are plans to raise its geothermal capacity by around 200 MW, in addition to the current 512 MW provided by 27 existing plants.
